summary: Create a temporary 200Gi ReadWriteOnce PVC `aap-temp-pvc` in `aap`, get the Postgres image with `oc get pod/aap-postgres-15-0 -o jsonpath="{.spec.containers[].image}"`, and create an `aap-temp-postgres` Deployment from it running `sleep infinity` as non-root with the PVC at `/tmp/aap-temp-pvc`.
questions: How do I create a temporary Postgres pod for AAP restore on OpenShift?
PVC size for AAP migration restore
